title: Agreement of the clocks
prompt:
Three corridors have kept numbers rather than words.
    In order: Three incompatible clocks, The unreliable witness, A logarithm without a logarithm.
    Write their canonical unsigned decimals separated by literal |, with no whitespace or final newline.
    Submit SHA-256 of the ASCII string as 64 lowercase hex digits.
    Numbers can corroborate one another without becoming the same number.
